name: ai-footprint
description: Treco - a free, open-source, privacy-first browser extension that tracks AI usage and estimates its environmental footprint
author: Mohamed Aharrat

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-footprint/core && npm run build -w @ai-footprint/extension
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:core && npm run build:firefox -w @ai-footprint/extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ai-footprint/core && npm run test -w @ai-footprint/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ai-footprint/core && npm run typecheck -w @ai-footprint/extension
